featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!
featured.rule:

* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in Tirana.  
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.  

**Event Rules for Event Staff**  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area

upcoming.name: Coffee-Spedition 9th anniversary
upcoming.description:
# PL:  
Drodzy kierowcy,  
    
Z okazji 9 lat istnienia Coffee-Spedition mamy zaszczyt zaprosić Was na nasz konwój urodzinowy. Minione lata były wyjątkowe, więc przeżyjmy tamte dobre chwile po raz kolejny.  
  
## Jak dołączyć do wydarzenia?  
Jeśli jesteś członkiem VTC i chciałbyś dołączyć ze swoją firmą, proszę otwórz ticket na naszym discordzie. Tam przekażemy Ci wszelkie informacje, oraz wyznaczymy miejsce, z którego Twoja firma będzie startować.  

Jeśli nie jesteś zrzeszony w VTC, lub chciałbyś pojawić się osobiście to poprostu wejdź na serwer w dniu wydarzenia i zajmij slot publiczny  
## Szczegóły wydarzenia:  
Data: 24 października 2026  
Godzina zbiórki: 19:00  
Godzina wyjazdu: 20:00  
Start: Frankfurt nad Menem (sloty)  
Miejsce docelowe: Antwerpia (Port kontenerowy)  
Komunikacja głosowa z innymi uczestnikami wydarzenia będzie odbywać się na discordzie Coffee-Spediton: https://discord.gg/c2EQMtpnd6  
### Dodatkowe informacje:  
- Na końcu wydarzenia każdy uczestnik zostanie poproszony o porzucenie/odstawienie naczepy i ustawienie się w miejscu docelowym samym ciągnikiem.  
# EN:  
Dear Virtual Truckers,  

Coffee-Spedition is celebrating its 9th anniversary. It was a great period of time for us and we'd like to invite you to our special convoy.  

## How to join our event?  
If you're a member of a VTC and would like to join with your company, please head to our discord and contact us using the ticket system. We'll provide you with all the necessary information and assign your company a starting slot.  
If you are not a member of a VTC or would like to join personally, simply join our server on the day of the event and take a public slot.  
## Event details: 
Date: 24 October 2026  
Meetup Time: 7:00 PM  
Departure Time: 8:00 PM  
Start: Frankfurt am Main (slots)   
Destination: Antwerp (Container port)  
Voice communication with other truckers and event staff will take place on Coffee-Spediton's discord server: https://discord.gg/c2EQMtpnd6 (main communication language is polish)  
### Additional information:  
- At the end of the event, each participant will be asked to dismiss/leave their trailer and line up at the destination with their truck only.

### Описание мероприятия
![](https://ykn-u.ru/cp/gallery/mp/IMG_1130.png)

Говорят, на дорогах Юкона волки воют не от голода, а чтобы собрать своих. Каждое воскресенье в 19:00 мы глушим шум будней и выходим в эфир единой стаей. Это наш ритуал. Наш код. Наш Воскресный YukonВой.

* **Сбор:** 18:30 (UTC+3)

**Event Rules for Participants**


* The Event Staff are recognized as; “Elite | Staff" or similar.

* Free roaming on the server is prohibited

* Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.

* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)

* Cars and Buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.

* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)

* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.

* Advertising on the server is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)

* Overtaking on the server is prohibited.

* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.

* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.

* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.

All other TruckersMP rules apply.

⭐ **Event Rules for Event Staff**


*Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.

*Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.

*Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.

*Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff

All other TruckersMP rules apply.
